map.断面法储量估算 使用指南: Section method reserve estimation user guide
map.输入两相邻断面面积、断面间距、矿石体重与品位，用断面法（平行剖面法）计算体积与储: Input two adjacent section areas, section spacing, ore bulk density and grade; compute volume and reserve by the section method (parallel-section method)
map.断面法 V = Σ(A_i×L_i): Section method V = sum(A_i x L_i)
map.两剖面间体积：已知相邻两勘探线断面面积与间距，求块段体积与矿石量: Volume between two sections: given adjacent exploration-line section areas and spacing, find block volume and ore quantity
map.边界外推：当一侧无工程控制时用楔形/锥形端角外推，结果须打折处理: Boundary extrapolation: when one side has no engineering control, use wedge/cone end-angle extrapolation, and the result must be discounted
map.金属量初算：叠加平均品位得金属量，辅助经济评价: Initial metal quantity: stack average grade to get metal quantity, aiding economic evaluation
map.：算法：平均断面 =（S₁+S₂）/2；体积 V = 平均断面 × 断面间距 L: : algorithm: average section = (S_1+S_2)/2; volume V = average section x section spacing L; ore quantity Q = V x bulk density D; metal quantity P = Q x grade C / 100. Applies to layered or vein ore bodies with stable occurrence and linear transition between two sections (local computation).
: example: two parallel sections S_1=800 m^2, S_2=600 m^2, L=50 m, D=2.8 t/m^3, C=0.8% -> average section=700 m^2, V=35000 m^3, Q=98000 t (98,000 t), P=784 t.
map.两断面形态差异很大时还可用吗？: Can it still be used when the two sections differ greatly in shape?
map.差异过大说明矿体形态变化剧烈，平均断面法误差增大。可改用块段法或地质统计学，并对: Excessive difference means the ore-body shape changes sharply and the average-section method error grows. Switch to block method or geostatistics, and handle the tip pinch-out/extrapolation sections separately.
map.未填品位时金属量按 0 处理。正式估算应插值或取相邻工程品位，不应留空，否则会系: When grade is blank, metal quantity is treated as 0. Formal estimation should interpolate or take adjacent engineering grade, not leave blank, otherwise metal quantity is systematically underestimated.
